400 Bad Request when creating response with invalid model

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
begin
  api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
  client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
  result = client.create_response_async(LiterLlm::CreateResponseRequest.new(input: '"Hello"', model: 'nonexistent-model'))
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
